metadata.name: default
metadata.description: Image-backed sandbox on the OpenSandbox lifecycle server. codex and OpenClaw both run against the Omniroute gateway, which the setup step writes into the workspace.

setup: mkdir -p .openclaw && printf '%s\n' '{' '  models: {' '    providers: {' '      omniroute: {' '        baseUrl: "https://omni-route.funfiesta.games/v1",' '        apiKey: { source: "env", provider: "default", id: "OPENAI_API_KEY" },' '        auth: "api-key",' '        api: "openai-responses",' '        models: [' '          { id: "auto/best-coding", name: "auto/best-coding", api: "openai-responses" },' '        ],' '      },' '    },' '  },' '  update: { checkOnStart: false },' '}' > .openclaw/openclaw.json5 && cat .openclaw/openclaw.json5
